comments.body: For those willing to arrive to India quick, you just need to do some "Battle Reports" quests, even the r1 quests give a good amount of fame, easier than doing the story-line or trying to get fame by other means.

comments.author: DiNozzo
comments.body: I would rather earn adventure fame for port permits because fame acquisition is halved after reaching 20k and adv fame is the hardest of the three to earn.

comments.author: Hawthorne
comments.body: When I was working on another character a few months before the game closed, I noticed that only applied to the category you got 20k+ in. So although you stop earning bonus experience and fame once you reach the threshold in Battle, for example, you will still earn bonus experience and fame in Trade and Adventure. That is, until you reach the threshold in those categories too.
